summary: HortusFox is a collaborative plant management and tracking system designed for plant enthusiasts. It provides a centralised web interface to record and monitor plant care tasks and collection details among multiple users. The application is built using PHP and is distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice for hobbyists or households wanting a dedicated, self-hosted tool to track plant care schedules collaboratively rather than relying on generic note-taking apps.
watchOut: The software addresses a very specific niche, meaning you may find fewer integrations, community plugins, or extensive documentation compared to more mainstream self-hosted options.
deployNotes: As a PHP application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
